en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the new-born, should one shave off his head after the seventh day?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the seven days pass by, so the shaving (of the head) is not upon him’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-‘Amrakiy ibn Ali from Ali ibn Ja‘far from his brother abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the newborn: if shaving his head after seven days from his birth is required.
He (the Imam) said, ‘When seven days pass shaving is not required.’”
